[[Jute Scrap]]s are tier one [[basic crafting material|basic]] [[crafting material]]s. Two scraps can be [[refinement|refined]] into a [[Bolt of Jute]] by [[Armorsmith]]s, [[Leatherworker]]s, [[Scribe]]s and [[Tailor]]s. They can be salvaged from level 0-20 [[light armor]].

== Trivia ==
* [[w:Jute|Jute]] is a strong, coarse fiber used for making [[w:Hessian fabric|burlap]], [[w:Gunny sack|gunny]], [[w:Cordage|cordage]], etc., obtained primarily from two East Indian plants, [[w:Corchorus capsularis|Corchorus capsularis]] and [[w:Corchorus olitorius|C. olitorius]], of the [[w:Linden tree|linden]] family.
